correctness.rationale: In the edge-spin convention, the interaction centered at a vertex v of K_n is J[(n−1−2d_v)²−(n−1)]/2; each bond of the line graph is counted exactly once. The field contributes hΣd_v−h binom(n,2), so the specified h gives C_n+2JΣ(d_v−1)². Handshaking forces odd square defect, and using respectively one and three isolates with the other vertices matched attains 1 and 3 at every stated n, giving gap 4J. At defect one the only components beyond isolated matched pairs are one isolate or one length-two path, giving the stated D_0. At defect three the exceptional degrees are exactly three zeros and/or twos. Degree-one endpoints canonically orient each matched endpoint pair, so orders and weak compositions of the labeled degree-two vertices count the paths without duplication. The only possible cycle is the triangle on all three exceptional vertices, with the remaining endpoints directly matched. The four terms simplify to 1/3+4m/3+m²+m³/6 after extracting the common factorial/double-factorial; the ratio and cubic asymptotic agree. Parity forces all remaining energies to be at least E_0+8J, and the finite-state remainder is for fixed n. In a separate bounded check of the original spin Hamiltonian, all 1024 configurations at n=5 and J=1 gave the two lowest (energy,multiplicity) pairs (−18,45), (−14,170). The frozen verify_excited.py and its reported n=5,7 checks were inspected, not executed. Neither finite check is the proof for arbitrary odd n.

originality.rationale: The same-graph field-staircase theorem already establishes the special ground sector and D_0 and gives a degree-profile energy with a general multivariate coefficient enumerator. This is material overlap: the simple parity argument for the 4J gap is also accessible from that energy identity, and the prior enumerator determines multiplicities implicitly. The supported distinct claim is the closed evaluation of the complete defect-three level for every odd n by the path/triangle decomposition, with its resulting cubic relative coefficient. The inspected general enumerators do not supply that evaluation; a prescribed degree sequence and coefficient extraction identify the count but do not evaluate it into this formula by direct substitution.
residual_risks: A stronger explicit closed formula for labeled simple graphs of prescribed counts of degrees zero, one and two might supply the evaluation; the bounded lookup did not establish such coverage. The older field-staircase result is already a source for the degree energy and exact implicit multiplicities.

value.rationale: This is the first finite-temperature coefficient at a field where the ground sectors are parity-degenerate, a natural quantity not determined explicitly by the zero-temperature staircase. The all-odd-order count resolves the contribution of both paths and the triangle and shows a cubic relative enhancement that an unevaluated degree-vector sum does not expose. The claim wisely stays at fixed n and does not infer a joint-limit transition.
